exam_scheme.note: Combined competitive examination structure comprising a common Preliminary screening test for all Non-Gazetted Group B posts, followed by cadre-specific Main written examination papers (Paper 1 common, Paper 2 specific), with an additional physical test and interview for the PSI cadre.

stages.stage_name: Maharashtra Non-Gazetted Group B Services Combined Preliminary Examination
stages.source_label: MPSC Advt. No. 011/2026 Scheme of Combined Preliminary Examination

papers.paper_name: General Ability Test (General Studies, Maharashtra History/Geography, Polity, Economics, General Science, Aptitude & Arithmetic)

stages.stage_name: Maharashtra Non-Gazetted Group B Services Main Examination
stages.source_label: MPSC Advt. No. 011/2026 Main Examination Pattern

papers.paper_name: Paper 1 — Marathi and English (Common for all Group B Cadres: Marathi 50 Qs / 100 marks, English 50 Qs / 100 marks)
Paper 2 — General Studies and Cadre-Specific Subject (Tailored to STI / PSI / ASO / Sub-Registrar)

stages.stage_name: Physical Test & Interview (applicable to PSI Cadre only)

papers.paper_name: Physical Efficiency Test (PET, 100 marks qualifying at 60%) & Oral Interview (40 marks for PSI only; no interview for STI/ASO)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 60% on PET qualifying to reach interview stage (PSI only)

financial_package.note: Pay Level S-14 under Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019 (Maharashtra 7th Pay Commission) for Subordinate Services Group B posts.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019, Government Resolution No. RPS-2019/CR-1/Services-9
financial_package.estimate_note: Basic pay ₹38,600 in Level S-14 (₹38,600 - ₹1,22,800). Computed with 58% DA (₹22,388) and HRA ranging from 9% (Z-class towns) to 27% (X-class metro cities like Mumbai/Pune), plus post-specific conveyance and uniform allowances where applicable, minus mandatory deductions (NPS 10%, Professional Tax, GIS).
official_perks: Government quarters or House Rent Allowance (HRA up to 27% in metro postings)
Cadre-specific field travel and inspection conveyance allowances
Medical facilities under Maharashtra State Government Employees Health Scheme
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and defined annual leave entitlements
Contributory pension scheme benefits under NPS
